name: Mnemoverse Memory
tagline: Hosted long-term memory for AI agents, shared across Cline and your other MCP clients
description:
Mnemoverse is a hosted memory engine for AI agents, reached over MCP. `memory_write` saves a memory and `memory_read` finds it again by a natural-language query, so what an agent stores from Cline is there in Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code or ChatGPT on the same account. Rating a recalled memory as helpful or misleading re-ranks what comes back next. Several agents can work from one memory through shared rooms.

Sign-in is OAuth in the browser with your Mnemoverse account, so there is no key to paste. The free plan includes 1,000 queries a day and needs no credit card.

Docs: https://mnemoverse.com/docs/api/remote-mcp-server

install.notes: To run the MIT package `@mnemoverse/mcp-memory-server` locally over stdio with an API key instead, use the Cline block in the repository README.
